purpose: Windows render-to-capture endpoints for browser microphone delivery to example, recorders and UE5

candidates.finding: Capture WriteBytes fills its DMA buffer with RtlZeroMemory; render ReadBytes writes to a file. This is not the required render-to-capture virtual cable.
candidates.signing_evidence: Current README requires test signing. Public GitHub releases API returned an empty list; old search snippets about signed releases were not accepted as current package evidence.
candidates.decision: Do not deploy as the microphone bridge

candidates.finding: Driver source contains a render-to-capture loopback buffer and documents 48 kHz stereo PCM. Documented installation requires test signing and Secure Boot disabled.
candidates.source_evidence: driver/src/LoopbackBuffer.cpp; driver/README.md; README.md driver signing sections
candidates.decision: Source candidate only. No installation or production adoption; kernel safety, build, production signing and endpoint behavior remain unverified.

next_acceptance_requirements: Package accepted under normal Windows kernel signing policy
Explicit endpoint identities and recorded proof of render-to-capture flow
Client test tone present, program test tone absent, silence after controller revocation
No system-default audio changes or unrelated service modifications
Source, license, reproducible build and signing provenance before production packaging
remaining: No production-signed dedicated virtual capture device deployed; Windows recorder/UE5 microphone delivery is not complete.
